10089|0e051c59.name: Silvaria
10089|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

10219|572db4df.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
10219|572db4df.text: May Elune walk with you, $c.  The Temple of the Moon has come to help the troubled citizens of Auberdine.

11083|53d41aed.name: Darianna
11083|53d41aed.text: It's so exciting to be here in Darnassus, surrounded by talented people! I just know I'm going to make my family proud. Maybe if I'm really lucky, the Sentinels will ask me to join their forces on the front!

11866|f3b1497b.name: Ilyenia Moonfire
11866|f3b1497b.text: The grace with which I fight is not something I can teach you, but I can teach you the use of various weapons.

1515|778f03ac.name: Executor Zygand
1515|778f03ac.text: The Scarlet Crusade is encroaching on our homeland. The foolish zealots do not realize that the loyal servants of The Dark Lady shall see to their demise.

2079|26ba7149.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
2079|26ba7149.text: Ah, the beauty of Shadowglen never ceases to delight my senses!

2080|ac9bd966.name: Denalan
2080|ac9bd966.text: The creation of Teldrassil was a grand achievement, but now the world must shift to regain its balance.

257446|3123e450.name: Teo Hammerstorm
257446|3123e450.text:
The stone an' soil speak truer than any tongue, if ye quiet the clatter in yer heart long enough to hear 'em. 

If ye've the makings of a shaman, I'll teach ye.

267327|d8b814ea.name: Kagil
267327|d8b814ea.text: Agol ne wirsh ver ne vandar novaedi veld algos nevren? Va se ras uden vrum bor garde?

267328|3f01eec2.name: Norzsh
267328|3f01eec2.text: You think you got what it takes to mine ore?

267333|0371bf6f.name: Terunne Bearshaper
267333|0371bf6f.text: Care to learn how to gather leather from slain beasts? Or do you need some new tools?

267336|0371bf6f.name: Brighid Stormflayer
267336|0371bf6f.text: Care to learn how to gather leather from slain beasts? Or do you need some new tools?

270582|e6b98502.name: Mon'ye
270582|e6b98502.text:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?

2930|cd94cda6.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
2930|cd94cda6.text: Corruption sneaks into nature's grove.  The forest must be protected at all costs.

3155|0402cd55.name: Rwag
3155|0402cd55.text: The Shattered Hand will see the Horde to their former glory, unhindered by the timidness of the Warchief.

3170|0402cd55.name: Kaplak
3170|0402cd55.text: The Shattered Hand will see the Horde to their former glory, unhindered by the timidness of the Warchief.

3194|57542108.name: Vel'rin Fang
3194|57542108.text: I make sure Sen'jin is supplied with materials from the local beasts. It is an honorable role.

3296|4b39ad06.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|4b39ad06.text: Find Red Canyon Mining northeast of the lake in the Valley of Honor.  Speak to Makaru there.

3306|0e051c59.name: Keldas
3306|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

3567|0cdab46e.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
3567|0cdab46e.text: Well met, $N. It is good to see that warriors like yourself are taking an active part in protecting the groves.

3567|8f79505e.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
3567|8f79505e.text: Well met, $N. It is good to see that hunters like yourself are taking an active part in protecting the groves.

3601|497f7ea2.name: Dazalar
3601|497f7ea2.text: There are many places that you might visit in Teldrassil.  Tell me what you seek.

3605|08c2dba0.name: Nadyia Maneweaver
3605|08c2dba0.text: You need to make your stitches smaller, $N. Fewer items will slip out of your quivers and ammo pouches. Besides, no one likes a lumpy tunic.

3605|c7a4e3ad.name: Nadyia Maneweaver
3605|c7a4e3ad.text: Welcome to our home, $N. Radnaal and I have little to offer, but you are welcome to what hospitality we can provide.

3616|29aa26bd.name: Onu
3616|29aa26bd.text:
The wind whispers to those who listen...

Do you hear it?

3702|5ae56d71.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
3702|5ae56d71.text: Hello $r, it is a pleasure to make your acquaintance.

3838|43c9021b.name: Vesprystus
3838|43c9021b.text: To maintain our link to the mainland, we have hippogryphs constantly flying between Rut'theran Village and Darkshore.

4088|c486e91d.name: Elanaria
4088|c486e91d.text: A $c's path is one of determination, sister.  It may begin with strength of arms, but it endures through force of will.

4156|c2467ddc.name: Astaia
4156|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

4200|c2e88775.name: Laird
4200|c2e88775.text: Although the coast of Darkshore is more dangerous than that of Teldrassil, many fishers find profit here.

4210|0c543544.name: Alegorn
4210|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

4241|b0e0696e.name: Mydrannul
4241|b0e0696e.text: It is my honor to provide for adventurers, for they are heroes in the making.

460|86b6c1ef.name: Alamar Grimm
460|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

6300|0b719f6c.name: Elisa Steelhand
6300|0b719f6c.text: How can I help you, friend?

6301|021e8521.name: Gorbold Steelhand
6301|021e8521.text: Greetings lass, if you're looking for the best deals you'll find outside of Ironforge itself, then you've come to the right place.

6376|721fd095.name: Wren Darkspring
6376|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

714|7dd450ba.name: Talin Keeneye
714|7dd450ba.text: Greetings, $c! Fine day for hunting, wouldn't you say? I've been having more than a little luck with boars, myself. Perhaps you'd like a shot?

786|b76e4f1a.name: Grelin Whitebeard
786|b76e4f1a.text: Greetings, lad. I'm Grelin Whitebeard. I'm here to examine the threat posed by the growing numbers of trolls in Coldridge Valley. What have I found? It's a bit troubling...

836|b62f5856.name: Durnan Furcutter
836|b62f5856.text: I sell the finest cloth and leather garb this side of the valley!

944|391e3eaa.name: Marryk Nurribit
944|391e3eaa.text: Well met, $c.  You want some advice?  Befriend a mage!  We have a trick or two up our sleeves, we do...

1001-complete.name: Unknown
1001-complete.text:
The Buzzbox hums to life soon after you place the Thresher Eyes inside. There is a moment of static before you hear a familiar tiny voice call out.

"Crawler wine is the best..." *hic*

"What? Oh, you fixed it already? Wow, you're a fasht one. Sho, would ya like to fix another?"

You believe you hear a liquid being poured into a cup, followed by loud gulping sounds.
1001-complete.title: Buzzbox 411

1001-progress.name: Unknown
1001-progress.text: The machine's hatch is open and it seems to wait expectantly for 3 Thresher Eyes to be placed inside.
1001-progress.title: Buzzbox 411

1002-accept.name: Unknown
1002-accept.text:
The Buzzbox gives a burst of static as you hear Wizbang begin to speak.

"The next Buzzbox is number 323. Ish north of Auberdine but... where's the ale? Wha? Oh, ish on the road sho ya shouldn't have trouble finding it near the bridge."

Wizbang mumbles something incoherent before you hear a loud gulping sound.

"Thish one needs Moonstalker Fangs... 6 of 'em."
1002-accept.title: Buzzbox 323

1138-accept.name: Gubber Blump
1138-accept.text:
I love crab.  Crabs are the fruit of the sea!  You can bake it, barbecue it, boil it, and broil it.  They're pan fried, deep fried, and stir fried.  There's crab salad, crab soup, crab stew, pepper crab, lemon crab, whipper root crab, and Ironforge surprise crab.  That's... that's about it.

I'm here fishing right now, so I can't get any fine crab chunks.  You can pick them out of reef crawlers and encrusted tide crawlers.  You can make a lot with it.  You can bake it, barbecue it, boil it...
1138-accept.title: Fruit of the Sea

1579-complete.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
1579-complete.text: I can't believe you found them!  You must be the luckiest $r in Kalimdor!
1579-complete.title: Gaffer Jacks

1579-progress.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
1579-progress.text: Did you find my gaffer jacks, $N?  Without my gaffer jacks I can't tune my stintle pegs!
1579-progress.title: Gaffer Jacks

1580-accept.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
1580-accept.text:
We know you're lucky, but... just how lucky are you, $N?

One night I was wandering the roads of Darkshore.  I was looking for a good river or lake to try my new self-propelled, exploding duck decoy and I think I was a little tipsy... because I passed out and awoke hours later in Auberdine.  My hair was singed and my bag of electropellers was gone!  I must have dropped them in the water!

I need those electropellers!  Maybe you can fish them out of some lake or stream in Darkshore...
1580-accept.title: Electropellers

1580-complete.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
1580-complete.text:
I can't believe it!  You found them!  You are the best fisherman I've ever seen!

Thank you, $N.  And here, take these.  Although you're so good and you probably don't need them, they will help you with your fishing.
1580-complete.title: Electropellers

1580-progress.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
1580-progress.text: Did you find any electropellers?  I'll need them if I'm to continue my research on duck decoys...
1580-progress.title: Electropellers

1599-accept.name: Alamar Grimm
1599-accept.text:
You must be the new $c everyone's been whispering about. Must be someone's taken a liking to you if they've asked me to take time away from my research to start your training.

Don't worry, I won't hold it against you.

The simplest of the summoning spells you will learn is that of the imp. Before I impart this to you, however, you must prove that you have the necessary magical and physical ability.

Bring me three feather charms from the frostmane novices from the cave to the southwest.
1599-accept.title: Beginnings

1599-complete.name: Alamar Grimm
1599-complete.text:
Very good, very good! You've done well, $N. Perhaps the interest that is being shown in you is deserved, after all.

That'll be for the others to decide--assuming your imp doesn't overpower you and nip your career in the bud. For now, I'm satisfied that you'll probably survive your first few months as a $c.

A word about the imp, $N. As a $r knows, don't let its size fool you, its magic can be very dangerous.
1599-complete.title: Beginnings

1599-progress.name: Alamar Grimm
1599-progress.text: Those feather charms the novices carry have some sort of magical power to them. It will be interesting to research them. I wouldn't have expected it from the trolls.
1599-progress.title: Beginnings

1683-accept.name: Elanaria
1683-accept.text:
Before I can teach you, you must show me your resolve.

The satyr Vorlus Vilehoof has found one of our remote moonwells, southeast of the Ban'ethil Barrow Den.  He now splashes within it, defiling its pure waters with his filth.

Find Vorlus at the moonwell and destroy him.  Bring me his horn as proof and I will begin your advanced training as a $c.

The path to the moonwell is hidden well, $N, but stay focused and alert and you will find it.
1683-accept.title: Vorlus Vilehoof

1683-complete.name: Elanaria
1683-complete.text:
Well done, $N.  It is good to know Vorlus is defeated and our moonwell cleansed, and it is good to see young warriors eager to keep our beloved Teldrassil free of corruption.

Now let us begin your training...
1683-complete.title: Vorlus Vilehoof

1683-progress.name: Elanaria
1683-progress.text: Do you have the horn, $N?  Is our moonwell free of the fiend Vorlus?
1683-progress.title: Vorlus Vilehoof

1684-complete.name: Elanaria
1684-complete.text: I bid you greetings, $N.  Your name rings loudly in Darnassus, for you show promise.  But we shall soon see if you possess the strength of will to follow the path of the $c.
1684-complete.title: Elanaria

1686-accept.name: Elanaria
1686-accept.text:
You have learned much, $N.  Now we will craft you a weapon.  A $c's weapon.

To do this, you must travel to Darkshore.

Long ago a ship crashed upon the rocks near the Auberdine lighthouse, scattering many crates of elunite ore along the ocean floor.

First, you must defeat the elunite's guardian, the Shade of Elura.  Once the ship's captain, she cursed herself to roam the deeps and protect her shipment for all time.  Defeat her, gain her medallion, and gather the crates of lost Elunite.
1686-accept.title: The Shade of Elura

170-accept.name: Balir Frosthammer
170-accept.text:
I hope you're here to lend us a hand, $c. After the last trogg attack, we could use all the help we can get.

I hear the buggers have been popping up all across the lands, and it seems Coldridge Valley is no exception. They've been spotted all over the hills to the southeast and near the frozen lake.

And that's not all, just a few nights ago, they attacked and overran our camp to the west! 

We're a bit shorthanded here, lad, and we need strong arms to help drive the troggs back.
170-accept.title: A New Threat

170-complete.name: Balir Frosthammer
170-complete.text: If the problems we've had here are indicative of what is happening elsewhere in our lands, by Magni's beard, we have some troubles ahead of us! I can only hope that the king and Senate are taking steps to deal with the threat the troggs pose.
170-complete.title: A New Threat

179-complete.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-complete.text: Ah! Wonderful. The wolf meat should do nicely. Oh, don't worry, $N, I wouldn't forget my part of the bargain. Here, one of these should fit you.
179-complete.title: Dwarven Outfitters

179-progress.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-progress.text: Wolves giving you a bit of trouble? You'd do well to avoid the fangs and claws and other sharp bits, yes?
179-progress.title: Dwarven Outfitters

182-accept.name: Grelin Whitebeard
182-accept.text:
My brother Senir and I were sent to different parts of Dun Morogh to investigate the threat posed by the trolls. The Senate has its hands full with the troggs, so they've no need for further annoyances.

From what I've seen, the trolls aren't well situated here in Coldridge Valley--mostly the southern cave. I'd say that the army will not be necessary. A few strong arms should be more than enough.

Perhaps you'd like to assist in this endeavor? I have the authority to offer compensation for your help.
182-accept.title: The Troll Cave

182-complete.name: Grelin Whitebeard
182-complete.text:
Argh! Those Light-blasted trolls!

<He takes a few breaths and seems to settle down... a bit.>

A group of them came in the night and stole my journal! I knew better than to trust that good-for-nothing appr...
182-complete.title: The Troll Cave

183-accept.name: Talin Keeneye
183-accept.text:
Nothing like a day of boar hunting, eh?

Though, here in Coldridge Valley, there are so many boars it almost takes the fun out of it. No need to get them charging. They're all angry and ready without any help. In fact, recently, there've been so many boars in the area, it's become dangerous for me to do my daily hunting.

Long story short, if you could help me kill some of the boars, I would appreciate it.
183-accept.title: The Boar Hunter

183-complete.name: Talin Keeneye
183-complete.text: Excellent! I can go back to my... leisurely... hunting now. Thank you, $N.
183-complete.title: The Boar Hunter

2159-accept.name: Porthannius
2159-accept.text:
Greetings, young $c.  Can you offer me aid?  I have a package of herbs that I must deliver to the town of Dolanaar.  But I still have business with the druids of Shadowglen and cannot yet leave.

Can you deliver this package for me?  It must be sent to Innkeeper Keldamyr, at the Dolanaar inn.  It lies along the road, to the south.
2159-accept.title: Dolanaar Delivery

2159-complete.name: Innkeeper Keldamyr
2159-complete.text:
Ah yes, the delivery of herbs from Shadowglen.  It is a shame Porthannius could not bring it himself, for we have much to discuss, he and I.  But I am glad to get the herbs nonetheless, and I am glad you came.

While you are here, please, rest yourself.  Heroes must keep their strength and spirits high, and must find rest and solace whenever they may.  For to neglect one's peace of body and mind is a sure path to failure.

So... rest.
2159-complete.title: Dolanaar Delivery

2159-progress.name: Innkeeper Keldamyr
2159-progress.text: How might I be of service to you, young one?  Are you here to rest in the inn?  Do you require a hearthstone?
2159-progress.title: Dolanaar Delivery

2160-accept.name: Hands Springsprocket
2160-accept.text:
Hey! You look like a hearty adventurer. If you're planning on braving the pass, do you suppose you could bring a package to the inn in Kharanos?

You were planning on stopping at the inn, right? If you make it through the pass, you'll definitely want to take a breather there.

Anyways, bring this to Tannok Frosthammer, the innkeeper's assistant. I can't get through the pass myself, and it'll be days until a Mountaineer escort comes through!
2160-accept.title: Supplies to Tannok

2160-complete.name: Tannok Frosthammer
2160-complete.text:
Ah, at last, the supplies from Hands! I was beginning to worry, we've had scarce word from Anvilmar ever since the troggs overran the pass.

Thanks for bringing this to me, $N. And please, make yourself comfortable. You must be tired after your journey.
2160-complete.title: Supplies to Tannok

2160-progress.name: Tannok Frosthammer
2160-progress.text: Hi there! Come in, take a seat by the fire and warm yourself with a flagon of ale.
2160-progress.title: Supplies to Tannok

2178-complete.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
2178-complete.text: Fantastic! Try it and tell me what you think, $N!
2178-complete.title: Easy Strider Living

2178-progress.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
2178-progress.text: The pot is empty and I'm hungry! What's taking you so long?
2178-progress.title: Easy Strider Living

218-accept.name: Grelin Whitebeard
218-accept.text:
My journal! They took it away to the cave. The one that had it... It was a big brute with some odd markings on his skin and face. I didn't get a much better look than that.

You've had some luck with the trolls, maybe you could go get it back for me?
218-accept.title: The Stolen Journal

218-complete.name: Grelin Whitebeard
218-complete.text:
Wonderful, $N! Many thanks for retrieving my notebook. Well, it would seem that the troll situation here in Coldridge Valley is under control and not much cause for worry.

After I put the finishing touches on my report, I'll need someone to courier it to my brother Senir.
218-complete.title: The Stolen Journal

233-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
233-accept.text:
Hm, I don't suppose you'd be willing to do a favor for me, lad? A stack of letters came through the pass today, but I don't have the time to send them along.

They're all addressed to Talin Keeneye. You can find him to the west down the road. He's set up camp next to the frozen lake.

What do you say?
233-accept.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

233-complete.name: Talin Keeneye
233-complete.text:
Thank you, I've been waiting for these letters for quite some time...

Unfortunately, these letters aren't all for me. This one is addressed to Grelin Whitebeard. He's not too far away if you'd like to deliver it to him.
233-complete.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

233-progress.name: Talin Keeneye
233-progress.text: Yes? Do you have something for me?
233-progress.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

234-accept.name: Talin Keeneye
234-accept.text: If I remember correctly, Grelin's camp is down the road to the southeast. No doubt he'll be eager to get his mail.
234-accept.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

234-complete.name: Grelin Whitebeard
234-complete.text: Ahh, excellent. It's been a while since I received word from Ironforge. Ach, these letters from me mum warm my heart. Here, not fair you don't get some readin', too. Take one of these manuals we have lyin' around.
234-complete.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

234-progress.name: Grelin Whitebeard
234-progress.text: Is there something I can help you with?
234-progress.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

2438-accept.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2438-accept.text:
I was once given an emerald dreamcatcher from Gaerolas Talvethen, the warden of the druids in the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. This powerful amulet is able to siphon energy from the Emerald Dream, bestowing luck upon those who carry it.

Sadly, I have not been able to retrieve it from my dresser in Starbreeze Village... Although Starbreeze was once a tranquil place, it has now succumbed to the corruption of the furbolg that reside there.

Perhaps you would be willing to recover my dreamcatcher, $c?
2438-accept.title: The Emerald Dreamcatcher

2438-complete.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2438-complete.text: My emerald dreamcatcher is of great importance to me. It is a gift only given to few. Thank you for returning it, $N.
2438-complete.title: The Emerald Dreamcatcher

2438-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2438-progress.text:
Please move swiftly. I can only hope that my emerald dreamcatcher has been unharmed by the furbolg.

Have you recovered it yet, $N?
2438-progress.title: The Emerald Dreamcatcher

2459-accept.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2459-accept.text:
The emerald... It is missing! My dreamcatcher has been damaged!

There is a band of Gnarlpine mystics located to the north of Starbreeze. I have heard reports that their leader, Ferocitas the Dream Eater has been wearing a necklace that glows green in the night. Now seeing my dreamcatcher, I am sure that he has stolen my emerald... He would never realize that its power is useless to him.

Find this missing jewel, $N. And, while you're there, clear out some of the corrupted mystics as well.
2459-accept.title: Ferocitas the Dream Eater

2459-complete.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2459-complete.text: Now I can repair my dreamcatcher.  Thank you, $N.
2459-complete.title: Ferocitas the Dream Eater

2459-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2459-progress.text: Ferocitas and the Gnarlpine mystics must return what is mine.  Please retrieve the emerald so that I may repair my emerald dreamcatcher.
2459-progress.title: Ferocitas the Dream Eater

2498-accept.name: Rellian Greenspyre
2498-accept.text:
I have just received word that  Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth has discovered what may be the cause of the tumors that plague the timberlings. Please speak with him, and tell him I sent you.

Make haste, $N; he needs our help.
2498-accept.title: Return to Denalan

2518-accept.name: Priestess A'moora
2518-accept.text:
Lady Sathrah was once beloved of Elune. Graceful and pure, the spider spun her silver threads through the moonlight, catching the evening mist. The silvery dew had strong healing powers and was kept here in the temple.

But of late, Sathrah has descended into madness. Her future generations are now threatened as well.

Find Lady Sathrah, $N, and end her suffering. She dwells along the northern borders of Teldrassil, near Wellspring Lake. Gather her silvery spinnerets and bring them back to me.
2518-accept.title: Tears of the Moon

2519-accept.name: Sister Aquinne
2519-accept.text:
A once great creature of the forest is in need of help, $r.

There is a difficult task that must be done.

Please seek out Priestess A'moora; she will explain things to you. Find her to the southeast of here, inside the Temple of the Moon.
2519-accept.title: The Temple of the Moon

2541-accept.name: Oben Rageclaw
2541-accept.text:
The Gnarlpine shaman that inhabit this place have discovered a way of separating a sleeping druid's spirit from the physical body. The furbolg have animated my physical form and are using it to attack anyone that attempts to explore the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. I am now trapped in the Emerald Dream, powerless to stop this.

You must help me. The Gnarlpine shaman carry a strange charm which is used to perform this ritual, and I'd like to examine it. Please, $N, bring one to me.
2541-accept.title: The Sleeping Druid

2541-complete.name: Oben Rageclaw
2541-complete.text:
Thank you, $N.

What an odd trinket this is... I can sense the vile aura emanating from it; this is a very powerful enchantment.
2541-complete.title: The Sleeping Druid

2541-progress.name: Oben Rageclaw
2541-progress.text: If I can examine the charm, I may be able to figure out how to break the enchantment. Have you found one?
2541-progress.title: The Sleeping Druid

2561-accept.name: Oben Rageclaw
2561-accept.text:
After examining this charm, $N, I see now what must be done. Please take it, and do as I ask.

You are to explore the deepest areas of the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. There, you will find my soulless body... Although I regret what I am about to tell you, I see no other way to free myself from the control of the Gnarlpine.

In order for me to escape them, you must kill my physical form.  Once that is done, use the voodoo charm on my fallen body. After you have completed this task, please return to me.
2561-accept.title: Druid of the Claw

2561-complete.name: Oben Rageclaw
2561-complete.text:
I am finally free of the control of the Gnarlpine. Thank you, $N.

My spirit may now rest peacefully forever in the Emerald Dream.

Perhaps one day we may meet again, young $c. But, for now, please accept this reward as a symbol of my gratitude.
2561-complete.title: Druid of the Claw

282-accept.name: Grelin Whitebeard
282-accept.text:
I was planning on sending my apprentice to my brother Senir with my report, but I would feel much better were it placed in more... reliable hands. That is, of course, if you wouldn't mind?

Hmm... you'll have to take the tunnel to get to Kharanos.

Speak with Mountaineer Thalos before going through the tunnel. It's completely infested with troggs now.

Follow the road back to Anvilmar, then keep heading east to the tunnel, Thalos is stationed nearby.
282-accept.title: Senir's Observations

282-complete.name: Mountaineer Thalos
282-complete.text:
Hm, well, if Whitebeard is sending you to Dun Morogh on important business, I can't very well stop you, can I?

At least let me provide you with some advice and directions.
282-complete.title: Senir's Observations

282-progress.name: Mountaineer Thalos
282-progress.text:
Hail! Have a care, $N, the tunnel to Dun Morogh is infested with troggs and is not safe for travel.

If you haven't any pressing business in Dun Morogh, I'll have to ask you to remain in Anvilmar until the tunnel is safer.
282-progress.title: Senir's Observations

3083-accept.name: Gornek
3083-accept.text:
Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, $N.

Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the $c trainer Rwag. He would have words with you when you're ready.
3083-accept.title: Encrypted Tablet

3083-complete.name: Rwag
3083-complete.text: Until such time comes, you'll be under my tutelage. I will show you the ropes as some folks say. Whenever you feel prepared, come to me and I will see about training you further. Until then, practice your skills and keep them honed to a razor's edge. You'll never know when you'll need even the most insignificant ability.
3083-complete.title: Encrypted Tablet

3083-progress.name: Rwag
3083-progress.text:
Welcome to the Valley of Trials, $N. You wouldn't be here if you hadn't gotten my tablet, so I will get to the point.

I am Rwag and I am responsible for training the rogues, thieves, and cutpurses here in the Valley. I'm the one the Hand will turn to if you're not ready for what's to come. But don't worry, the Hand won't be controlling everything you do, but it would be wise to work with them if they have need of your talents.
3083-progress.title: Encrypted Tablet

3115-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
3115-accept.text:
While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the $c trainer Alamar. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.

And watch yerself, $N, your kind ain't too trusted 'round these parts.
3115-accept.title: Tainted Memorandum

3115-complete.name: Alamar Grimm
3115-complete.text:
But none of that matters. What matters is that you've seen your own Holy Light! You know where power truly comes from. You realize that having our own allies is much more... prudent. Special allies. Allies that, no matter the task, will obey till their last breath.

And that's where I come in, $N. I can train you in the beginnings of those special powers. Seek me out often and I will do what I can to teach you more spells.
3115-complete.title: Tainted Memorandum

3115-progress.name: Alamar Grimm
3115-progress.text:
Wonderful! You got my memorandum obviously.

Ignore the fools around you, $N. The Holy Light?! The sword and shield?! These aren't paths for ones as open minded as us. Look at what "normal" magic did to our home. Coupled with  those damned tinkerers, our race almost became extinct. And now we have to rely on the dwarves-- they'd rather spend time allying with humans than help us rebuild our own home. We're like second-class citizens. Have you seen the way they look at us?
3115-progress.title: Tainted Memorandum

3117-accept.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
3117-accept.text: This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our $c trainer, Ayanna. It seems Ayanna would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to her afterwards.
3117-accept.title: Etched Sigil

3117-complete.name: Ayanna Everstride
3117-complete.text:
As you experience what Shadowglen has to teach you, come see me--I will be able to help you understand more about your role as a $c and what you are capable of.

These are dangerous times, $N, do not take for granted the skill of your pets--there are things in this world more dangerous than you can imagine. Go with Elune and return to me again.
3117-complete.title: Etched Sigil

3117-progress.name: Ayanna Everstride
3117-progress.text:
You've arrived, and none too soon, $N. Welcome to Shadowglen.

I trust my sigil found you in good spirits and health?

As I said previously, I am here to train you as a $c; to tame beasts to aid you in battle; to use a bow with unerring accuracy; to respect the lands which we call home and also the lands beyond.
3117-progress.title: Etched Sigil

3361-accept.name: Felix Whindlebolt
3361-accept.text:
We drove the troggs out of Gnomeregan, but then it all went so horribly wrong!  Now our home is completely irradiated, and we gnomes have been scattered all over Dun Morogh.

In my haste to get away from the radiation, I lost all my personal belongings and tools.  It was the trolls that got them.  They stole my chest, my box, and my bucket of bolts!  They took them back to their camps southwest of Anvilmar.

I'm no adventurer - could you find my things and bring them here to me, please?
3361-accept.title: A Refugee's Quandary

3361-complete.name: Felix Whindlebolt
3361-complete.text: Huzzah, you've found them!  You're an absolute savior, my friend.  Here, it's not much, but it's something for the trouble I've put you through!  Thank you!
3361-complete.title: A Refugee's Quandary

3361-progress.name: Felix Whindlebolt
3361-progress.text:
Oh goodness $N, this town is not well suited for the likes of me.  There are as many nasty creatures here as there were in Gnomeregan before the accident!

Do you have my belongings?  If you don't, then who knows what the trolls have done with them now...
3361-progress.title: A Refugee's Quandary

3364-accept.name: Nori Pridedrift
3364-accept.text:
Gah!  I was supposed to get this delicious scalding mornbrew to Durnan Furcutter inside Anvilmar a while ago now, but I had to deliver one to Grelin here first.  I'll never make it to Anvilmar before the brew runs cold!

You look fast.  Maybe you can make it.  This cup will only stay hot for five more minutes, and Durnan didn't order "chilly" mornbrew, so get going.  Anvilmar is to the northeast, a settlement dug into the mountain.

Thanks, $N, and don't forget to bring me back my mug!
3364-accept.title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery

3364-complete.name: Durnan Furcutter
3364-complete.text: Ah good, now this will hit the spot.  Allow me to take a small break while I enjoy this scalding mornbrew!
3364-complete.title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery

3364-progress.name: Durnan Furcutter
3364-progress.text: Aye, I'm Durnan Furcutter.  You have something for me?
3364-progress.title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery

3365-accept.name: Durnan Furcutter
3365-accept.text:
Now that hit the spot!  Nothing like a piping hot - nay, SCALDING mornbrew on a cold winter's day to warm your cackles of yer soul.

Here ya go $N - be a pal and take this empty mug back to Nori for me, would ya now.
3365-accept.title: Bring Back the Mug

3365-complete.name: Nori Pridedrift
3365-complete.text:
Excellent, $N!  You'd be surprised how many couriers I meet who forget to do something as simple as bring back the mug.  Mugs don't grow on trees, or so they tell me!

Here's a little something for the effort.  Thanks again for your help.
3365-complete.title: Bring Back the Mug

3365-progress.name: Nori Pridedrift
3365-progress.text: I trust the scalding mornbrew got to Durnan on time!  Did you remember to bring me back my mug?
3365-progress.title: Bring Back the Mug

3519-accept.name: Iverron
3519-accept.text:
Ughhh... I was bitten very badly by a spider named Githyiss the Vile while exploring the spider cave very close to here. I am sure I have been seriously poisoned; you must help me.

Please tell Dirania Silvershine. She will be able to help me.

Hurry... I'm so dizzy...
3519-accept.title: A Friend in Need

3519-complete.name: Dirania Silvershine
3519-complete.text: Oh dear; I was wondering why I hadn't seen Iverron yet today. And I've always warned him about those spiders...
3519-complete.title: A Friend in Need

3521-accept.name: Dirania Silvershine
3521-accept.text:
We may be able to help Iverron, as I know of an antidote that should help with the poison. It requires some ingredients, though, before I can make it.

I'll need Hyacinth mushrooms. You can find these growing under trees, or you may collect them from the grell south of here; they seem to have taken a liking to them. I'll also need Moonpetal lilies, which only grow around watery pools.

The last ingredient may prove the most difficult. From the very spiders that poisoned Iverron, collect Webwood ichor.
3521-accept.title: Iverron's Antidote

3521-complete.name: Dirania Silvershine
3521-complete.text:
Thank Elune that you have gathered these ingredients so quickly!

In just a moment, I will have the antidote prepared.
3521-complete.title: Iverron's Antidote

3521-progress.name: Dirania Silvershine
3521-progress.text: Please, collect the ingredients, $N. Iverron needs our help.
3521-progress.title: Iverron's Antidote

3522-accept.name: Dirania Silvershine
3522-accept.text:
The antidote is ready, $N. Please see that Iverron drinks it.

There is something that you should know -- the antidote -- it will only remain viable for 5 minutes. You must get it to him in time.

Speed be with you, $N.
3522-accept.title: Iverron's Antidote

3522-complete.name: Iverron
3522-complete.text:
What is this, $N?

Oh, I knew Dirania would be able to help me!

<Iverron drinks the antidote.>

I'm always getting into trouble and Dirania, well, she always manages to help me out of it.

I am feeling much better, but I think I will sit here for a while longer, until I feel completely better. Well, that, and I was hoping you'd clear a path for me through those vicious Webwood spiders...
3522-complete.title: Iverron's Antidote

3522-progress.name: Iverron
3522-progress.text: Oh... $N, I'm so glad you have returned.
3522-progress.title: Iverron's Antidote

370-complete.name: Executor Zygand
370-complete.text: Captain Perrine's death will undoubtedly please The Dark Lady.  You have performed your duty well, $c.
370-complete.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

371-accept.name: Executor Zygand
371-accept.text:
We are still at war and the Scarlet Crusade grows in strength.  The report Executor Arren sent me indicates Scarlet Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in southeastern Tirisfal near the Balnir Farmstead under the command of Captain Vachon.

Kill Vachon along with 5 Scarlet Friars. It should prove to be a devastating blow to the Crusade!
371-accept.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

374-complete.name: Deathguard Burgess
374-complete.text: Varimathras would be proud.  You serve your leaders well, $c.
374-complete.title: Proof of Demise

374-progress.name: Deathguard Burgess
374-progress.text: Have you collected 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings yet, $c?
374-progress.title: Proof of Demise

384-accept.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
384-accept.text:
Nothing my tavern patrons enjoy more than some Beer Basted Boar Ribs!  Only problem is, the local trapper who used to bring me supplies enlisted in the King's Army to help with the war on the Alliance front. 

Maybe you can help me out?  If you bring me six crag boar ribs and a Rhapsody Malt from the tavern here, I'll give you the family recipe for my famous Beer Basted Boar Ribs, not to mention a free sample!  The secret's in the Malt!
384-accept.title: Beer Basted Boar Ribs

400-accept.name: Tharek Blackstone
400-accept.text:
Beldin Steelgrill owns the local mechanic shop, and he's the best siege engine tech there is!  But he's not forgiving to his tools.  I swear he almost breaks more arclight spanners than we can supply him with!

We just filled his last order for tools.  If you deliver it to him I'm sure he'll make it worth the effort.

His shop, Steelgrill's Depot, is just northeast of Kharanos.  And it's a local haunt for veteran siege engine pilots, so keep your ears open for opportunities while you're there.
400-accept.title: Tools for Steelgrill

404-complete.name: Deathguard Dillinger
404-complete.text: Well done.  I regret not being there to see you smash those $r into rotting pulp!
404-complete.title: A Putrid Task

404-progress.name: Deathguard Dillinger
404-progress.text: Have you completed the task with which I have charged you?  Do you have those putrid claws?
404-progress.title: A Putrid Task

4161-accept.name: Zarrin
4161-accept.text:
Long ago, the night elves were called the kaldorei, a name that means "children of the stars." Learning of the past is an important step in your path as a $c, $N, so listen well to what I have to tell you.

The kaldorei have always taken much pride in their harmonious relationship with nature. This means that we only take from nature what is necessary, and that we return in kind. This balance has afforded us much, $N.

Go out and collect seven small spider legs -- no more than that, and return to me.
4161-accept.title: Recipe of the Kaldorei

4161-complete.name: Zarrin
4161-complete.text: Always remember what I have shown you today, $N. You are part of the balance that the night elves strive to keep intact, even during troublesome times.
4161-complete.title: Recipe of the Kaldorei

4161-progress.name: Zarrin
4161-progress.text: Remember the balance, $N. I wish you to develop an understanding and a strong empathy for the living forests.
4161-progress.title: Recipe of the Kaldorei

420-accept.name: Mountaineer Thalos
420-accept.text:
The troggs in the tunnel are extremely hostile, and haven't shown any hesitation in attacking travelers through the tunnel. You seem tough enough, though, so you should probably be safe.

Directions? If you're going to speak with Senir, you'll find him in Kharanos.

Make your way through the tunnel, and after you come out on the other side, just keep following the road, it'll run right into Kharanos.
420-accept.title: Senir's Observations

420-complete.name: Senir Whitebeard
420-complete.text:
What's this? Ah, my brother's report. Hmm...

I told him to be sparing with the use of the King's name, but he didn't listen. No harm, I suppose, though it's sure to ruffle some feathers in the Senate. Not that those weren't some feathers that needed ruffling! Hah!

Nonetheless, I guess that means that I should send my report on to Ironforge as well, but I must admit I'm a bit behind. Bloody cold.

I should have some work for you later, if you're interested.
420-complete.title: Senir's Observations

420-progress.name: Senir Whitebeard
420-progress.text: How are you? Like to share a drink with me, perhaps? Not much else to do in the cold.
420-progress.title: Senir's Observations

426-accept.name: Deathguard Dillinger
426-accept.text:
The Scourge are trying to form a base at the Agamand Mills.  If they do, then they can stage further attacks within Tirisfal.

The orders have been given.  The Scourge in the Mills must be destroyed.

Go to the Mills.  Collect Notched Ribs from Rattlecage and Cracked Skull Soldiers, and Blackened Skulls from Darkeye Bonecasters.

To get to the Mills, follow the road west.  After crossing the bridge, take the next fork north then keep going north.  When you see windmills, the battle will begin.
426-accept.title: The Mills Overrun

4402-complete.name: Galgar
4402-complete.text: Wonderful, $N! As promised, here is your cactus apple surprise. Pick one of these training manuals, too. I've got plenty to go around.
4402-complete.title: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise

4495-accept.name: Dirania Silvershine
4495-accept.text:
A friend of mine named Iverron usually visits me at the same time every day. The strange thing is that he hasn't been by today at all -- he's several hours late, in fact.

I admit, I am a little worried, $N. Iverron spends a lot of time over by the cave to the north, and I'm sure you know how dangerous it is there -- spiders, everywhere!

If you happen to be going that way, though, will you keep an eye out for him?
4495-accept.title: A Good Friend

4495-complete.name: Iverron
4495-complete.text: I'm so glad you found me, $N. How did you know I was here?
4495-complete.title: A Good Friend

456-accept.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
456-accept.text:
Greetings, $N.  I am Conservator Ilthalaine.  My purpose in Shadowglen is to ensure that the balance of nature is maintained.

The spring rains were particularly heavy this year, causing some of the forest's beasts to flourish while others suffered.

Unfortunately, the nightsaber and thistle boar populations grew too large.  Shadowglen can only produce so much food for the beasts.  Journey forth, young $c, and thin the boar and saber populations so that nature's harmony will be preserved.
456-accept.title: The Balance of Nature

457-accept.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
457-accept.text:
Thinning the younger population of creatures here in Shadowglen was a good start, $N, but there is still work to be done.

The resources of the forest will be depleted too quickly if the problem is not addressed.  Killing nature's beasts is a necessary evil for the good of all who share the land.  Venture into the forest and slay mangy nightsabers and thistle boars in the name of balance.
457-accept.title: The Balance of Nature

457-complete.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
457-complete.text: You have proven your dedication to nature well, $N.  A young $c like yourself has a promising future.
457-complete.title: The Balance of Nature

458-accept.name: Melithar Staghelm
458-accept.text:
Thank goodness you are here, $c. Strange news has traveled to me through the whisperings of the forest spirits.

The mysterious woodland protector, Tarindrella, has returned to Shadowglen. The dryad's presence has not been felt in the forests of Kalimdor in years. Something is surely amiss if she has journeyed back to this land.

Seek out Tarindrella and see what business she tends to in our grove. One of the Sentinels reported seeing her to the southwest of Aldrassil.
458-accept.title: The Woodland Protector

458-complete.name: Tarindrella
458-complete.text: I see you found me, young $r.  Melithar is a wise druid to have sent you. But you still have much to learn. I understand your kind enjoys books. Please take one of these to further your education.
458-complete.title: The Woodland Protector

459-accept.name: Tarindrella
459-accept.text:
Something evil is brewing in the forests of Teldrassil.  Look long the hills to where the peaceful furbolgs used to dwell.  They have deserted their homes and are amassing under the name of the Gnarlpine tribe.

Only the corruption of wicked Fel Moss could cause such a transformation.  The grells and grellkin have infested the area and are threatening the residents of Shadowglen.  

Engage these grells and grellkin, $N, and see if they are indeed caught under the enchantment of the wicked Fel Moss.
459-accept.title: The Woodland Protector

459-complete.name: Tarindrella
459-complete.text:
Your service to the creatures of Shadowglen is worthy of reward, $N.

You confirmed my fears, however.  If the grells have become tainted by the Fel Moss, one can only imagine what has become of the Gnarlpine tribe of furbolgs who once lived here.

Should you find yourself in Dolanaar, able $C, seek out the knowledgeable druid, Athridas Bearmantle.  He shares our concern for the well being of the forest.
459-complete.title: The Woodland Protector

459-progress.name: Tarindrella
459-progress.text: Satisfy my suspicions, $N.  Bring to me 8 Fel Moss.
459-progress.title: The Woodland Protector

4681-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4681-complete.text:
You've been a tremendous help here today; we now have a solid chance at unlocking the mystery of why these creatures choose to beach themselves on the coast of Darkshore.  The idea that they might be fleeing the area around Teldrassil is disturbing.  Should you come across others in your travels, please let me know.  Our research here is but in its infancy.

On behalf of the Temple of the Moon, please accept this as thanks for the effort you have given.  Thank you, $N!
4681-complete.title: Washed Ashore

4681-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4681-progress.text: Once you have investigated the creature's remains in the water to the west of here, I should be able to file a proper report with the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.  Perhaps then we will be closer to discovering the reason why these unfortunate creatures choose to end their lives beached on the coast of Darkshore.
4681-progress.title: Washed Ashore

4740-accept.name: Unknown
4740-accept.text:
Attention!

A reward is being offered for the death of the murloc "Murkdeep".  This foul beast is known to be responsible for the death of at least one Sentinel, and is suspected of causing the sinking of at least two cargo vessels in the waters off Darkshore!

Murkdeep was last spotted at a hutted murloc camp south of Auberdine, and is thought to be protecting the huts there.  Reward claims for this bounty should be claimed with Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

The Auberdine Village Council
4740-accept.title: WANTED: Murkdeep!

475-accept.name: Athridas Bearmantle
475-accept.text:
A troubling breeze blows through the forest.

Gaerolas Talvethren serves as Great Warden to the hibernating Druids of the Talon in the Ban'ethil Barrow Den.  His duty as the chosen protector of the Sleeping is to ensure their safety so that their pact with Ysera remains fulfilled.

But word from Gaerolas is now delayed and I grow nervous.  Travel east to Starbreeze Village and bring back a report from Gaerolas so that I can put my worries to rest, knowing my dreaming brethren slumber safely.
475-accept.title: A Troubling Breeze

475-complete.name: Gaerolas Talvethren
475-complete.text: Thank the forest spirits you are here!  I knew Athridas would sense trouble and send help.
475-complete.title: A Troubling Breeze

476-accept.name: Gaerolas Talvethren
476-accept.text:
The Gnarlpine tribe has been corrupted!

The once peaceful furbolgs have turned against the protectors of the forest.  They ambushed me as I left for the Ban'ethil Barrow Den and proceeded to pillage Starbreeze Village.  Ursal the Mauler, their chieftain, is using the evil powers of the Fel Moss to drive them mad.

I am too wounded to return to Athridas to bring him this grave news.  The task is left to you, young $c.  We can only hope that the deranged Gnarlpines have not made it to Ban'ethil yet!
476-accept.title: Gnarlpine Corruption

476-complete.name: Athridas Bearmantle
476-complete.text: By the stars!  This is quite disturbing indeed!
476-complete.title: Gnarlpine Corruption

4811-complete.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
4811-complete.text:
So the crystal exists, $N?  Fascinating... anyway, your task has been well executed; good work!

What exactly is this crystal?  This is but a single question in a sea of questions.  Another question that comes to mind is why the moonkin would be drawn to this object?  Is the crystal benign in nature, or does it hold a more sinister purpose?

I have many more questions, but we're going to need to examine that crystal closely to get some answers.
4811-complete.title: The Red Crystal

4812-accept.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
4812-accept.text:
Use this empty vial and fill up on some moonwell water here in Auberdine.  Such potent magic should provide a clue as to the composition of the crystal.  To do that, you'll pour the liquid over the crystal; it should take care of the rest.

While I don't anticipate anything bad happening to you, I still want you to be careful.  Above us to the east is Felwood; if that crystal is tied to that place as I suspect it is, then it could prove to be very dangerous.
4812-accept.title: As Water Cascades

483-accept.name: Athridas Bearmantle
483-accept.text:
Gnarlpine invaders were seen ravaging the Ban'ethil Barrow Den to the west.

The slumbering druids will be trapped in the Emerald Dream for eternity, unaware of their fate, unless we help. The delicate hibernation ritual cannot be broken without the Relics of Wakening.

Journey to the Den and retrieve the Raven Claw Talisman, Black Feather Quill, Sapphire of Sky, and Rune of Nesting. The druids store them in sacred chests.  Return them to me and I will prepare the awakening ritual.
483-accept.title: The Relics of Wakening

483-complete.name: Athridas Bearmantle
483-complete.text: You have succeeded, young $c!  Well done.  And just in time I might add.
483-complete.title: The Relics of Wakening

483-progress.name: Athridas Bearmantle
483-progress.text:
$N, the kidnapped Druids of the Talon will be forever trapped in the Emerald Dream if we cannot retrieve the Relics of Wakening from the Ban'ethil Barrow Den to the west.

For every minute we delay their fate comes one step closer to eternal doom.
483-progress.title: The Relics of Wakening

486-accept.name: Athridas Bearmantle
486-accept.text:
Now the time has come to save the Druids of the Talon. If we fail now, $N, they will be forever lost in sleep.

I shall prepare the Relics of Wakening and perform the ritual. For my work to take effect, the cursed beast responsible for this horrible situation must be slain. Only then will the ritual be complete.

It was Ursal the Mauler who meddled with our brethren's calling and it is Ursal the Mauler who must now pay so they can be freed. Travel to Gnarlpine Hold in the southwest and slay him.
486-accept.title: Ursal the Mauler

486-complete.name: Athridas Bearmantle
486-complete.text:
$N, you have proven yourself a most worthy and able $c. A $r who follows the path of honor as sure as you do is certain to find great glory in this world.

May the forest spirits protect you wherever your travels may take you.
486-complete.title: Ursal the Mauler

487-accept.name: Moon Priestess Amara
487-accept.text:
The road to Darnassus must be kept safe.  Travelers heading from Dolanaar to Darnassus have been reporting ruthless attacks by corrupted furbolgs from the Gnarlpine tribe.

Important news and commerce travels to and from Darnassus by way of this road daily.  We cannot afford to have a rogue band of heathens terrorizing people.

Take up arms in the name of the sacred forest, $c.  Their den lies somewhere below this vantage point.  Slay 6 of these Gnarlpine ambushers and report back to me.
487-accept.title: The Road to Darnassus

487-complete.name: Moon Priestess Amara
487-complete.text: You have served the good people of Dolanaar and Darnassus well, brave $c.  As a member of the Sentinel force of Teldrassil I salute your efforts.
487-complete.title: The Road to Darnassus

488-accept.name: Zenn Foulhoof
488-accept.text:
Eager for work, I see.  Lucky for you a day never goes by that I don't wish I had a fledgling $c to perform my bidding.

You see, $N, I can make you very happy and provide you with things you never dreamed of having.  But in order for that to happen you must bring me certain items.

My business in the forest often requires certain. . .reagents.  Fetch for me 3 Nightsaber Fangs, 3 Strigid Owl Feathers and 3 swatches of Webwood Spider Silk.

Let's keep this our little secret, $r.
488-accept.title: Zenn's Bidding

490-accept.name: Sentinel Shayla Nightbreeze
490-accept.text:
By strict orders from the Sentinels, I am commissioning a bounty on the Gnarlpine. They are no longer friends of the forest. Their corruption has left them mindless threats to our people and the creatures of the glade.

As decreed, you shall be rewarded for removing the furbolg menaces from Teldrassil. Bring to me their fangs as proof of your deeds.

You will find furbolg concentrated in Ban'ethil Hollow, west of Dolanaar and south of the road, and in Starbreeze Village to the east.
490-accept.title: Bounty: Gnarlpine Furbolg

490-complete.name: Sentinel Shayla Nightbreeze
490-complete.text: You have served well, $N. You shall be rewarded for your contribution.
490-complete.title: Bounty: Gnarlpine Furbolg

490-progress.name: Sentinel Shayla Nightbreeze
490-progress.text: Teldrassil cannot thrive with corruption tainting the land. Drive the Gnarlpine from this forest, once and for all.
490-progress.title: Bounty: Gnarlpine Furbolg

5482-complete.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5482-complete.text:
Ah, my doom weed. Excellent!

<Junior Apothecary Holland rubs his hands together greedily.>

These will come in quite handy. You've done me, uh, the Lady, a fine service today, $N. As promised here is the reward that you deserve.
5482-complete.title: Doom Weed

5482-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5482-progress.text: This had better be good. I trust you have all of the doom weed that I require?
5482-progress.title: Doom Weed

6063-accept.name: Dazalar
6063-accept.text:
As a $c, it is important to remember the responsibility you hold in your hands. Nature is not a power that can be bent to obey our desires; it is one that is to be respected and acknowledged as something stronger than your very existence.

$N, you must prove your understanding of this before you will gain the ability to tame an animal to be your companion.

Your first task is to take this taming rod. With it, you will be able to tame a webwood lurker. Tame it, and practice your skills as a $c.
6063-accept.title: Taming the Beast

6063-complete.name: Dazalar
6063-complete.text: Excellent, $N! You are quite a fast learner.
6063-complete.title: Taming the Beast

6063-progress.name: Dazalar
6063-progress.text: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $c.
6063-progress.title: Taming the Beast

6101-accept.name: Dazalar
6101-accept.text:
The variance of nature is something that can be relied upon, $N. It is predictable in the way that it never remains the same; it is always changing.

The tasks I give to you will help you to see and appreciate the vast differences of the creatures you may choose as your companion.

Take this taming rod and use it to tame a nightsaber stalker, found to the south. Practice your skills as a $c. Then you will begin to understand the similarities and differences of nature.
6101-accept.title: Taming the Beast

6101-complete.name: Dazalar
6101-complete.text: I see your commitment and that you have understood what I have taught you, $N.
6101-complete.title: Taming the Beast

6101-progress.name: Dazalar
6101-progress.text: Understanding the balance between nature and oneself is a way of life for every $r.
6101-progress.title: Taming the Beast

6102-accept.name: Dazalar
6102-accept.text:
You have tamed two creatures that inhabit the land, now you must tame one that soars the skies. Use the taming rod to tame a strigid screecher, found west of here. Practice your skills with this mighty owl at your side.

When you return, I will bestow you with the skills you will need to tame an animal of your choosing to be your companion; this creature will face the challenges you face, and gain experience alongside you. I will also show you how to call it and dismiss it as you wish.
6102-accept.title: Taming the Beast

6102-complete.name: Dazalar
6102-complete.text:
You have learned all I can teach you, $N. May I offer you one more piece of advice: use discretion when choosing your first pet. Will you choose a creature of the land, of the water, or of the sky? Whatever it may be, without doubt, your pet will be with you for quite some time.

Here you are, $N. I will now give you the power to tame a beast, as well as call it and dismiss it as you see fit. Use your new skills with pride; you have earned them.
6102-complete.title: Taming the Beast

6102-progress.name: Dazalar
6102-progress.text: I am proud of your accomplishments, $N. Have you finished the last task I gave you?
6102-progress.title: Taming the Beast

6103-accept.name: Dazalar
6103-accept.text:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it.

Travel to Darnassus. There you must speak to one of our most revered hunters, Jocaste. She will give you the ability to train your new pet, so make haste.

While Jocaste may seem stern, she is always pleased to see another $c rising through the ranks. Treat her with respect and she will return in kind. Good luck, $N.
6103-accept.title: Training the Beast

6103-complete.name: Jocaste
6103-complete.text:
A fledgling $c, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.

Remember, $N, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.
6103-complete.title: Training the Beast

6341-complete.name: Vesprystus
6341-complete.text: Ah, you wish to get this to Auberdine?  Very well...
6341-complete.title: The Bounty of Teldrassil

6341-progress.name: Vesprystus
6341-progress.text: How may I help you?  Are you in need of transport?
6341-progress.title: The Bounty of Teldrassil

6342-accept.name: Vesprystus
6342-accept.text:
From Rut'theran, there are two methods of travel to Auberdine: by ferry and by hippogryph.  Both are quick and reliable, but if you have not yet flown to Auberdine by hippogryph, then I suggest you do.

It is sound advice to speak with the hippogryph master in every town that has one.  Once you speak to the master, you can then fly there from other towns.

Here is Nessa's collection.  Speak with me again when you are ready to fly to Auberdine and deliver Nessa's collection to Laird.
6342-accept.title: Flight to Auberdine

6342-complete.name: Laird
6342-complete.text:
A package from Nessa?  Thank you, $N!  She told me she would send me samples of the fish caught near Rut'theran village.  She thinks they may be very different from the fish caught here...

My!  This jawbone is nearly twice the size of the same fish found here.  And these scales are as big as a closed fist!  Amazing!
6342-complete.title: Flight to Auberdine

6342-progress.name: Laird
6342-progress.text: Have you come from Teldrassil?  Tell me, how is the fishing there?
6342-progress.title: Flight to Auberdine

6343-accept.name: Laird
6343-accept.text:
I must send a response to Nessa.  She'll be very interested to know how different the fish here are from those along Teldrassil's coastline.  We can only guess the cause, but it is my suspicion that the world tree itself is affecting the wildlife around it!

Please, take this response to Nessa.  If you wish to take a hippogryph back to Rut'theran then speak with the hippogryph master Caylais Moonfeather.  If you wish to take the ferry, then one regularly departs from the dock to the northwest.
6343-accept.title: Return to Nessa

6344-accept.name: Mydrannul
6344-accept.text:
A friend of mine, Nessa Shadowsong, is a fishing merchant in Rut'theran Village.  She needs a parcel taken to Darkshore, and is looking for someone to help her.

If you're interested, then to reach Nessa you must take the portal in Darnassus to Rut'theran Village.  You will find the portal west of the Temple Gardens.
6344-accept.title: Nessa Shadowsong

6344-complete.name: Nessa Shadowsong
6344-complete.text: Yes, I have need of a courier who will take a package to Darkshore.  Will you help me?
6344-complete.title: Nessa Shadowsong

729-accept.name: Archaeologist Hollee
729-accept.text:
What an honor it was when Master Greywhisker assigned me to work under the guidance of the great Prospector Remtravel. At the academy in Ironforge everyone knew of Remtravel's great discoveries.

But the prospector is rather... um... oblivious ...to his surroundings.

We had uncovered evidence of a great society. Horrible golems sprang forth from the ground and overran the site. Remtravel never seemed to notice. I ran back to Auberdine for help.

Please travel south and see if the prospector is ok!
729-accept.title: The Absent Minded Prospector

7383-accept.name: Corithras Moonrage
7383-accept.text:
All was not well with Teldrassil, however. Staghelm's carefully made plans for the new World Tree had borne out as he had hoped, but there was one small problem, a problem to which many of the troubles on Teldrassil may be attributed.

However, I will not get into that yet. You must visit the last moonwell, to the northwest in the Oracle Glade. Under the boughs of the Oracle Tree lies the first and most powerful of our wells. Retrieve a phial of its water and return to me.
7383-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

7383-complete.name: Corithras Moonrage
7383-complete.text:
To be in the presence of the Oracle Tree... it is almost to feel wisdom take form. Let me continue the telling...

With Teldrassil grown, the Arch Druid approached the dragons for their blessings, as the dragons had placed upon Nordrassil in ancient times. But Nozdormu, Lord of Time, refused to give his blessing, chiding the druid for his arrogance. In agreement with Nozdormu, Alexstrasza also refused Staghelm, and without her blessing, Teldrassil's growth has been flawed and unpredictable...
7383-complete.title: Crown of the Earth

7383-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
7383-progress.text: Along with the druids, the Oracle Tree and the Arch Druid have been carefully monitoring the growth of Teldrassil. But though we have a new home, our immortal lives have not been restored.
7383-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

792-accept.name: Zureetha Fargaze
792-accept.text:
I trust the Valley of Trials will teach you much, young $c.

I was sent to the Valley to guide you, but I have discovered a growing taint here...

A group that calls itself the Burning Blade has a coven here in the Valley of Trials.  They are skulking in a cave to the northeast, and their Vile Familiars have spilled from its mouth to cause havoc.

As your first task against the Burning Blade, I bid you, defeat these familiars. Slay many and, if you survive, return to me.
792-accept.title: Vile Familiars

792-complete.name: Zureetha Fargaze
792-complete.text:
You have done well, $N.

Although the Vile Familiars were merely pets of the darker powers within the Burning Blade, your success against them foretells greater deeds ahead.
792-complete.title: Vile Familiars

815-complete.name: Cook Torka
815-complete.text:
You might be weak, but at least you're not clumsy, $N.

Here, take this and get outta my way. I've got cooking to do.
815-complete.title: Break a Few Eggs

815-progress.name: Cook Torka
815-progress.text: Breakfast, lunch, dinner! Who cares which meal it is? It still has to be cooked by someone--namely me!
815-progress.title: Break a Few Eggs

831-complete.name: Nazgrel
831-complete.text:
Countless times I urged the Warchief not to trust the humans, but personal pride is not what is at stake here.

You have served the Horde honorably, young $c.

Now excuse me, I must counsel Thrall on these matters at once....
831-complete.title: The Admiral's Orders

831-progress.name: Nazgrel
831-progress.text: Can you not see that I am busy? This had better be pressing....
831-progress.title: The Admiral's Orders

834-accept.name: Rezlak
834-accept.text:
I'm Rezlak, one of Gazlowe's boys. Boss sent me to help the orcs here in Durotar. Things'd been going good except for the caravans. Can't manage to keep them safe! Makes my job a little harder, you know?

The last shipment--they promised it'd get through!--was snatched by the Dustwind harpies of...where was it...Razorwind Canyon?

I gotta have those supplies or I'll never get anything done! Follow the big canyon to the south, you'll find the ravine cut right into the west and east sides of the walls.
834-accept.title: Winds in the Desert

86784-complete.name: Eleanor Shackleton
86784-complete.text:
Extra firewood? That is always welcome. It will keep these old bones warm through the cold nights of the Glades.

I have a sling for collecting wood myself, so you might as well hang onto that basket.
86784-complete.title: Sticks and Bones

87288-accept.name: Aldia
87288-accept.text:
Hello, traveler! I hope you are enjoying your visit to our village. I like Dolanaar because it is small and rustic and everyone is friendly.

I'm a local trader, and I bring in all sorts of tools and trinkets that might be useful to you in your travels. Indeed, if you are interested in a trade, I find myself in need of some nightsaber pelts. While these majestic creatures are beautiful, the local ones are rather aggressive, so don't feel too bad about defending yourself.
87288-accept.title: Soft Saber Pelts

87288-complete.name: Aldia
87288-complete.text:
Oh, these are wonderful. It is a shame to resort to violence with such majestic animals, but it is important to keep the roads safe, and these pelts will make beautiful blankets and shawls.

Here, let me give you something to remember them. It is both soft and sturdy.
87288-complete.title: Soft Saber Pelts

87288-progress.name: Aldia
87288-progress.text: It is good to see you again! Are you here to trade?
87288-progress.title: Soft Saber Pelts

916-accept.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
916-accept.text:
I came to Shadowglen to observe the webwood spiders that dwell in the Shadowthread Cave.  They are cousin to a much smaller variety of spider; I believe the world tree has had a profound effect on them, and I would like specimens to study to confirm this.

First, I would like some of their venom.  Gather Webwood venom sacs from the spiders in and around the Shadowthread Cave, to the north.  I can then examine them for similarities with their smaller cousin's venom.
916-accept.title: Webwood Venom

916-complete.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
916-complete.text: Thank you, $N.  When I return to Darnassus I will compare the venom within these sacs with the venom of other spiders.  It is my belief that it will have properties linked to the recent growth of our new world tree.
916-complete.title: Webwood Venom

916-progress.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
916-progress.text: Did you gather the venom sacs, $N?
916-progress.title: Webwood Venom

917-accept.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
917-accept.text:
Now that I have the spiders' venom, I'd like some live specimens to study.  Unfortunately, capturing a living, giant spider is more than I can ask of you, young $c.  And a giant spider is more than I could handle myself!

But if you can find an unhatched egg, then delivering specimens will be much easier, and I can then arrange for the unhatched spiders to be contained.

There must be a nest deep in the Shadowthread Cave.  Please, search for an egg in the nest and return it to me.
917-accept.title: Webwood Egg

917-complete.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
917-complete.text: Ah, very good.  I will have this egg and the venom transported to Darnassus, then return there when my studies are done here.  I expect to find out a great deal from these specimens, $N.  You have been a great help to me.
917-complete.title: Webwood Egg

917-progress.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
917-progress.text: Have you been inside the Shadowthread Cave, $N?  Did you find a spider egg?
917-progress.title: Webwood Egg

918-accept.name: Denalan
918-accept.text:
The timberlings of Teldrassil are elementals of nature.  In some ways they reflect the natural order of plants and animals on our great tree.

So it is disturbing to see how angry the timberlings have become.

I believe it has something to do with the soil.  I have been working on different methods of nurturing plants and would like to try them on timberling seeds.  Please, can you gather seeds from timberlings around Lake Al'Ameth and bring them to me?
918-accept.title: Timberling Seeds

918-complete.name: Denalan
918-complete.text:
You got them.  This is good!

I will plant these seeds in special soil I have prepared.  I believe the seeds will sprout into timberlings who are much more docile.  Perhaps later you can see the results!
918-complete.title: Timberling Seeds

918-progress.name: Denalan
918-progress.text: Do you have the seeds?  I am eager to plant them.
918-progress.title: Timberling Seeds

919-accept.name: Denalan
919-accept.text:
Small timberlings are sprouting around the waters of Lake Al'Ameth.  I'm afraid these sprouts are beyond help -- we should try to clear them from the land before they grow large enough to cause trouble.

When you're wandering the lake, if you see any timberling sprouts please take them.  Help keep our land clean!
919-accept.title: Timberling Sprouts

919-complete.name: Denalan
919-complete.text:
That's a lot!  I'm afraid they're spreading at a dangerous rate.  I hope I can solve the riddle of what is tainting them.

Thank you for your help, $N.  The land is a cleaner place from your efforts.
919-complete.title: Timberling Sprouts

919-progress.name: Denalan
919-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you found any sprouts near the waters?
919-progress.title: Timberling Sprouts

920-accept.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
920-accept.text:
$N, is it? I heard that Tenaron has been asking for you. You'll find him in the highest room atop Aldrassil.

We may live long lives, but it's best you not keep him waiting too long.
920-accept.title: Tenaron's Summons

920-complete.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
920-complete.text: Ah, $N. I was hoping you'd be prompt in answering my summons. I have an important task that I would like you to perform.
920-complete.title: Tenaron's Summons

921-accept.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
921-accept.text:
It is time for you to set out to seek your destiny, $N. But before you are ready to set out into the world beyond our enchanted forests, there is much you must learn about our recent history.

Much has changed with our people since the Battle of Mount Hyjal. Nordrassil lies a pale shadow of what it once was, its power used to defeat Archimonde and drive back the Burning Legion...

There is a task you must perform. Go to the moonwell north of Aldrassil and return me a phial of its water.
921-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

921-complete.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
921-complete.text: So you have heard the first part of the aftermath of the Battle of Mount Hyjal. There is much more to be told and the task you have begun here will continue through the rest of your journey through Teldrassil and into Darnassus.
921-complete.title: Crown of the Earth

921-progress.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
921-progress.text:
The moonwells hold the waters of the Well of Eternity, the ancient source of magic that has wrought so many horrors upon our world.

The druids take advantage of its properties, and the Sentinels revere the wells as shrines to Elune, but sorcery is forbidden to all.
921-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

922-accept.name: Denalan
922-accept.text:
$N, can you take one of the seeds you brought me to my friend, Rellian Greenspyre?  He is a druid in Darnassus, and when last we spoke he revealed his interest in my work with the Timberlings.  He had some ideas himself, and he will appreciate a specimen seed to work with.

Thank you, $N.  You have been a great help to me.  I hope that, some day, you will see the fruit of my labors.

You will usually find Rellian walking the pathways of the Cenarian Enclave in Darnassus.
922-accept.title: Rellian Greenspyre

922-complete.name: Rellian Greenspyre
922-complete.text:
Ah, a timberling seed?  I wanted to try growing one of these to help Denalan with his studies.

But I'm afraid I've discovered that a corruption has grown in many of the timberlings, and seeds from such creatures carry their parent's taint.  They are beyond my talents to repair.

Denalan is very skilled with things that grow.  He may find a cure for future timberlings.  He may be their only hope.
922-complete.title: Rellian Greenspyre

922-progress.name: Rellian Greenspyre
922-progress.text:
Hello...

And how may I help you?
922-progress.title: Rellian Greenspyre

923-accept.name: Rellian Greenspyre
923-accept.text:
There is a malevolence growing in the timberlings.  We are trying to find the source, but until we do...in order to keep Teldrassil safe we must cut down the timberlings who are beyond help.  Those that wander Wellspring Lake in northern Teldrassil are the most tainted.  They must be removed!

Destroy the Timberlings you find there, and gather the mossy tumors growing upon them.  Bring the tumors to me so that they may be burned.
923-accept.title: Tumors

923-complete.name: Rellian Greenspyre
923-complete.text:
Well done!  These tumors are the symptom of the timberling's disease.  They are filled with a poison that we must cleanse from our new land.

I will dispose of these tumors.  Thank you, $N.
923-complete.title: Tumors

923-progress.name: Rellian Greenspyre
923-progress.text: Have you been to Wellspring Lake, $N?  Have you been hunting the timberlings there?
923-progress.title: Tumors

928-accept.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
928-accept.text:
While there is more I could speak to you of the moonwells and of Teldrassil, I must send you along. Corithras Moonrage will be expecting you. I have poured the phial of water you brought to me into this vessel to bring to him.

Seek out Corithras. You will find him at the moonwell in Dolanaar. Follow the road south from Aldrassil out of Shadowglen, and continue to follow the cobblestones as the road turns west.

Mind you stay on the road though, $N. There are dangerous beasts in the forests of late.
928-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

928-complete.name: Corithras Moonrage
928-complete.text:
Ah, I see. You were sent by Tenaron. Well then, it would seem we have much to talk about, much to do, and little time to do it in.

I think we'd best get started.
928-complete.title: Crown of the Earth

928-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
928-progress.text: Greetings, $c. For what purpose do I owe the pleasure of our meeting?
928-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

929-accept.name: Corithras Moonrage
929-accept.text:
First, let me tell you more of the task you must complete. The druids in Darnassus use the water of the moonwells of Teldrassil, and their moonwell must be replenished from time to time. Using these specially crafted phials, you can collect the water of the moonwells.

Take this vessel to the moonwell outside of Starbreeze Village to the east, and fill it with some of its waters, then return to me. When you have completed your task, I shall continue the story where Tenaron left off...
929-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

929-complete.name: Corithras Moonrage
929-complete.text:
After the Battle of Mount Hyjal, we were without direction. Nordrassil smoked from the fire it unleashed, and our immortality--the very essence of our beings!--was lost.

It was in this trying time that the Betrayer was freed from his prison, and Shan'do Stormrage disappeared. A dark time for all.
929-complete.title: Crown of the Earth

929-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
929-progress.text: Hello again, $N. Have you completed your task?
929-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

930-accept.name: Unknown
930-accept.text:
Hanging from beneath its fronds of this glowing plant is a large, round fruit.

Denalan would want to study this fruit, you are certain.
930-accept.title: The Glowing Fruit

930-complete.name: Denalan
930-complete.text:
You found this on Teldrassil?  Intriguing... this fruit is exotic.  Perhaps its seeds were brought here from far off.  Perhaps even as far as Azeroth!  And there's something about this fruit... it seems to have reacted very strangely with the soil of Teldrassil.

Thank you, $N.  Now if you'll excuse me, I must study this further...
930-complete.title: The Glowing Fruit

930-progress.name: Denalan
930-progress.text: $N, you look like you have something to tell me.  Do you have news concerning the timberlings?
930-progress.title: The Glowing Fruit

932-accept.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
932-accept.text:
I must warn you, $N, this matter must stay between us. The satyr are enough of an embarrassment to us already, and this one is much too close to home.

He is called Lord Melenas. He resides in the nearby cave of Fel Rock where he has gathered a large group of grell warriors. His heart is black as night, and he plots something most foul.

You must find him within his nearby cave just to the north of here, and bring me his head.
932-accept.title: Twisted Hatred

932-complete.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
932-complete.text: With Lord Melenas laid to rest I can finally move on to other matters. Thank you, $N.
932-complete.title: Twisted Hatred

932-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
932-progress.text: Did you kill Lord Melenas yet? It is vital that he be taken care of quickly and quietly, $N. His continued existence is an embarrassment to us all.
932-progress.title: Twisted Hatred

933-accept.name: Corithras Moonrage
933-accept.text:
There is another moonwell southeast of the entrance to Darnassus, on the shores of the Pools of Arlithrien. The Sentinels are having problems patrolling the area because of attacks and the growing ill-temperedness of the Gnarlpine furbolgs.

Be wary as you seek out the well, and keep your weapons close at hand.
933-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

933-complete.name: Corithras Moonrage
933-complete.text:
Shan'do Stormrage never returned, and the druids were in disarray, and to this day we still do not know what became of him. With Malfurion missing, Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm took over the leadership of the druids, convincing the Circle of Ancients in Darkshore that it was time for our people to rebuild, and that it was time for our people to regain their immortality.

With the approval of the Circle, Staghelm and the most powerful druids grew Teldrassil, the new World Tree.
933-complete.title: Crown of the Earth

933-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
933-progress.text: At first the reports of crazed furbolg attacks were dismissed. Who could have thought that the peace-loving bear-men would turn to mindless rage? Yet another of the problems that plagues us here in our new home.
933-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

935-accept.name: Corithras Moonrage
935-accept.text:
