Without the blessings of Alexstrasza the Life-Binder and Nozdormu the Timeless, Teldrassil's growth has not been without flaw. Strange beasts have been reported arising from the very ground of the tree, and crazed furbolgs attack passing travelers.

I can only hope that the solution the Arch Druid is looking for will be found quickly. I will pour all the phials you brought into this vessel, for you to deliver to Darnassus.

Bring it to Fandral Staghelm, you will find him in the druid grove.
935-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

935-complete.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
935-complete.text:
Ah yes, the water I had requested. Tenaron and Corithras certainly took their time in having it delivered... perhaps not choosing the most reliable of messengers... hmm.

Nonetheless, I can finally get back to my work then. The weight of Teldrassil's problems fall upon my shoulders. A yoke I would wish to soon be rid of.

Take this, you may find some use for it.
935-complete.title: Crown of the Earth

935-progress.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
935-progress.text:
I know that I did not summon you, so I cannot help but wonder why it is you have come to speak with me.

Whatever it is, please make it quick.
935-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

937-accept.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
937-accept.text:
I was dispatched with a small group of Sentinels here to protect the Oracle Tree from the harpies that have made nests all around the glade. Little by little we are trying to push them back.

When the Oracle Tree attempted to send a runner to Darnassus with a report, the messenger was attacked and killed by a group of the harpies.

If you feel up to the task, go to their nests, slay them, and return their belts to me as proof of your deeds.
937-accept.title: The Enchanted Glade

952-complete.name: Onu
952-complete.text: Ah. Thank you, $N. It is strange, though. The Arch Druid always seems in such a hurry. The forest knows that all shall come to pass in the appointed time. Shan'do Stormrage understood that.
952-complete.title: Grove of the Ancients

952-progress.name: Onu
952-progress.text: Ah.$c. How may Onu assist you?
952-progress.title: Grove of the Ancients

953-accept.name: Sentinel Tysha Moonblade
953-accept.text:
To the east you will find the ruins of Ameth'Aran. It is now inhabited by the restless spirits of the Highborne that once dwelt within its walls, but once it was a place where the servants of Azshara freely practiced their powerful magics.

I was sent to explore the ruins and came across two large tablets, scrawled with the stories of Ameth'Aran and its fall. While I read the runes, I was accosted by the spirits, and fled.

Please, if you can, venture to the ruins and decipher the tablets in my place.
953-accept.title: The Fall of Ameth'Aran

953-complete.name: Sentinel Tysha Moonblade
953-complete.text:
We have few records from the time around the War of the Ancients, especially near the destruction of the Well of Eternity. Given the upheaval and cataclysmic events that were taking place, it is no big surprise.

Thank you, $N. With your help, my work here is finished, and I will be able to deliver a full report to the Circle.
953-complete.title: The Fall of Ameth'Aran

954-complete.name: Asterion
954-complete.text:
Ahh... To what could I possibly owe the exceedingly special honor of a $r such as yourself as company. Truly it says much of my current companions--with no offense to my hosts, the noble grells and satyrs--that your presence could be considered an improvement.

But please, do not let my uncivil tongue drive you from the place. It has indeed been many years, decades even, since I had civil accompaniment.
954-complete.title: Bashal'Aran

955-accept.name: Asterion
955-accept.text:
If I were to relate the story of my life, I have no doubt it would surpass the limits of your patience. Let us say that mine has been a long and painful life, and this spectral form is perhaps the worst torment of all.

I am held here by the means of magic. Though my words may seem disingenuous, I assure you I would be grateful beyond words if you would help me find the means of my imprisonment. A seal binds me, and by examining the earpieces of the sprites and grells, I may find a trace of it.
955-accept.title: Bashal'Aran

955-complete.name: Asterion
955-complete.text: Indeed... The grells of Bashal'Aran do not possess that which I am searching... however they have come into contact with it recently. Recently... I would reckon that by your time, not mine. Recent for me stretches into the veil of the past, almost another Age...
955-complete.title: Bashal'Aran

955-progress.name: Asterion
955-progress.text: Once I have the earrings, I will cast the spell to search for the whereabouts of the seal that binds me. For centuries I have thought on the freedom destroying the seal would bring to me... Perhaps those centuries have taken a toll upon my mind that I might never recover...
955-progress.title: Bashal'Aran

956-accept.name: Asterion
956-accept.text:
If the grells have come into close contact with the seal that binds my eternal prison, I suspect I know the cause. No doubt the seal has come into the possession of the satyr that lead them.

I feel strongly that this must be true, $N. One of the satyr must surely possess it. If you can obtain it, you would bring me so close to passing the bars of my prison that tears would come to my eyes.
956-accept.title: Bashal'Aran

956-complete.name: Asterion
956-complete.text: It... it is hard for me to even believe that what I hold now is that which has held me for so long. Let us waste no time, $N. When the seal is destroyed, I might walk the forests of the earth freely again.
956-complete.title: Bashal'Aran

956-progress.name: Asterion
956-progress.text:
The pillars of this shrine are as the bars of a prison to me, $N. No strength I still possess might break them, and no magic I wield might destroy them...

For a thousand years and more I have stared at them, wondering if at long last I outlived even the stone, would I be free? Or would it be invisible bars that held me then...
956-progress.title: Bashal'Aran

957-accept.name: Asterion
957-accept.text:
It was the craft of one of the most powerful of the Highborne that created the seal that formed my prison. In Ameth'Aran, the ruins to the south that are twin to these, persists even today an ancient flame, blue in color. In this flame this seal could be destroyed.

Be wary in the ruins, $N...
957-accept.title: Bashal'Aran

957-complete.name: Asterion
957-complete.text:
I am freed, $N! I can now see with my own eyes the changes that have come to our world... Only bits and pieces have I known. To think that when I last walked freely, the Well still stood and the Highborne held court with Azshara, our beloved queen.

I sense that my jailor, my former master, Athrikus, still lives... Already my feelings of hopelessness will give way into thoughts of vengeance.
957-complete.title: Bashal'Aran

958-complete.name: Thundris Windweaver
958-complete.text: Though it is surely a figment of my imagination, I feel as though I can almost feel the taint of foul Highborne magic upon them. I will have these destroyed, so that their long dormant evil might never be released again.
958-complete.title: Tools of the Highborne

958-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
958-progress.text: If only the tools of their undoing could have been destroyed in the cataclysm that destroyed our world... Nonetheless, we must do what we can to ensure that the horrors of our past are not repeated in the future.
958-progress.title: Tools of the Highborne

963-complete.name: Cerellean Whiteclaw
963-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Perhaps it would have been better... if I had done it myself. But even after these thousands of years, I could not bear to raise my hand against my beloved.

Please, I would be alone with my grief...
963-complete.title: For Love Eternal

963-progress.name: Cerellean Whiteclaw
963-progress.text: With a great sorrow in my heart, I followed the Shan'do Stormrage into hibernation, and took my sorrow to my dreams, sleeping for the passing of thousands of years.
963-progress.title: For Love Eternal

96604-complete.name: Brakk
96604-complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
96604-complete.title: The Great Outdoors

96606-accept.name: Lyreena Duskblade
96606-accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96606-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96628-accept.text:
Wait, $N. I have another ask of you, before you brave that tunnel.

My mountaineers have reported an adventurer that's shown up just outside of Kharanos. Could you deliver these supplies to him?
96628-accept.title: The Adventurer

96628-complete.name: Eric Brighthammer
96628-complete.text:
You say these are from the mountaineers? Aye, I could use them. Thank you, $c.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96628-complete.title: The Adventurer

96628-progress.name: Eric Brighthammer
96628-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96628-progress.title: The Adventurer

96630-accept.text:
<The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.

There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... fun.>
96630-accept.title: The Adventurer

96630-complete.text:

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?

96634-accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96634-accept.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96634-complete.name: Zarrin
96634-complete.text:
With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.

96821-accept.name: Vel'rin Fang
96821-accept.text:
We see fewer and fewer travelers from Razor Hill these days. The scorpids were never much fun, but now I hear there are spiders making their nest along the road.

If your travels take you up north, kill some of the spiders on your way. Then, let Razor Hill know the path's a bit safer for them.
96821-accept.title: Legging It

96821-complete.name: Gar'Thok
96821-complete.text: The peons have been scared to travel south for some time, $N. Now that you've cleared the path a bit, we can get them back to work.
96821-complete.title: Legging It

96822-accept.name: Turroc
96822-accept.text:
We lost many brave warriors of the Horde when we sacked Tiragarde Keep. Now that the humans have reinforced the ruins, we cannot collect their remains to properly honor their deaths.

Go to the ruins surrounding the keep, and search for the weapons left by our fallen kin. We will display them in a place of honor.
96822-accept.title: For Honor

96822-complete.name: Turroc
96822-complete.text: These warriors will always be remembered, $N. You have made sure of that.
96822-complete.title: For Honor

96822-progress.name: Turroc
96822-progress.text: Have you done what I asked?
96822-progress.title: For Honor

96825-accept.name: Cook Torka
96825-accept.text:
Our hunters and fishers bring back plenty of savory food for our troops - but it's rare that they get a sweet treat.

I've seen a cactus that produces a prickly, tasty fruit. But it only grows in the hills to the west, where the wretched quilboars make their camps. Make your way past the quilboars and bring me some of those fruits. And be careful - the fruits are as spiny as the quilboars!
96825-accept.title: This Fruit Could Bite Back

96825-complete.name: Cook Torka
96825-complete.text: I'll use these to prepare something tasty, and save the seeds for planting. Someday we'll have prickly pears growing all around Orgrimmar!
96825-complete.title: This Fruit Could Bite Back

96895-accept.name: Deathguard Terrence
96895-accept.text:
Not sure if you heard, but two emissaries of the Argent Dawn just passed through here. I don't mind the Argent Dawn, but I don't like them poking around Tirisfal unsupervised either. They were both Forsaken... but that doesn't make me any less nervous.

One of them just passed by here, headed southeast. There's a group of scourge cultists snooping around the outskirts of the city in that direction. If those two heard about them, there's no doubt that would have caught their attention.
96895-accept.title: The Argent Emissary

97223-accept.name: Xar'Ti
97223-accept.text:
All of the raptors you see before you are ones I have trained myself. They come from all over Kalimdor, but some of the finest come from the Bloodtalon raptors on the isles off our coast.

One raptor amongst them, the Bloodtalon Matriarch, is particularly savage and has killed many from our village and has become too dangerous to leave at our borders. If you can strike her down, return with her eggs so that we can raise the hatchlings as allies instead of enemies.
97223-accept.title: Bloodtalon Matriarch

97225-accept.name: Master Vornal
97225-accept.text:
When we fled the isles that Zalazane and his ilk now inhabit, we left behind many precious idols that help us commune with spirits we worship: our loa. They are of grave importance to our tribe.

The followers of Zalazane show no reverence for our loa and have scattered these idols across the largest of the isles.

This is an action that will not go unnoticed if we are not able to collect these idols, and offending a loa is a grave matter.

Go, find as many loa idols as you can and return them to me.
97225-accept.title: Forgotten Loa Idols

97277-accept.name: Grund Drokda
97277-accept.text:
Oi, had me back turned gettin' the boar roast ready when I heard me pal Gozwin screamin' fer his life!

Wicked fangs and a blur are all I saw when I turned. Such huge paws! A snow leopard was draggin' its gnomish catch away. I grabbed me shotgun and fired above the beast. It dropped him and sprinted off.

Luckily, it hadn't done more than give ol' Goz some deep scratches.

Head back to camp in the northwestern hills and retrieve Gozwin's Mechanic's Log. Kill that snow leopard too if you see it!
97277-accept.title: Grund and Gozwin

97277-complete.name: Grund Drokda
97277-complete.text:
Aye, I'm not surprised to hear that snow leopard was makin' a meal of the boar we were fixin' fer roastin'!

Goz will have one less thing to stress about now that you brought back his log book. Maybe now he can focus all his energy on gettin' back on his feet.

Thanks, $N. Take a little something as a token of my appreciation, fer makin' the trek, and fer protectin' the hills.
97277-complete.title: Grund and Gozwin

97277-progress.name: Grund Drokda
97277-progress.text: Poor Goz is more concerned for his mecha-walker than himself. Says if anyone gets a hold of that mechanic's log he's greased. Hah! That's why I told him he should just leave his work at home!
97277-progress.title: Grund and Gozwin

97279-accept.name: Gornek
97279-accept.text:
With an influx of new recruits like yourself, it's been hard to keep our weapons supplied. Our weaponsmith, Kzan, is running low on training weapons and I'd like to see what kinds of skills you possess to get an idea of what I have to work with. Luckily for you, I have a solution to both.

While you're out there cutting your teeth on boars, salvage six abandoned training weapons. Our failed recruits left them laying on the ground. Once you do, return them to our weaponsmith Kzan behind me in the Den.
97279-accept.title: Wayward Weapons

97279-complete.name: Kzan Thornslash
97279-complete.text: Thank you for returning these weapons, $N. I will get to work repairing them for the next wave of recruits.
97279-complete.title: Wayward Weapons

97279-progress.name: Kzan Thornslash
97279-progress.text:
Throm'ka, $c. Gorak told me I should be expecting you. It is good to see you in one piece!

Were you able to collect the training weapons I requested?
97279-progress.title: Wayward Weapons

97903-accept.name: Brakk
97903-accept.text:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
97903-accept.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97903-complete.name: Rawrk
97903-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own First Aid Kit. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97903-complete.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97904-complete.name: Lau'Tiki
97904-complete.text:
Dere ya have it, ya be craftin' your very own Fish Bowl. Most folk don't be carin' much for camps being set up in da center of town, so ya be needin' ta head into da wilderness if ya be wantin' to try it out.

No camp is complete without a campfire, mon. Ya be needin' one of dose before ya be startin' up your camp. Most cooks be teachin' ya ta make a fire. Check in with someone who can train ya in da culinary arts if ya haven't already learned da basics.
97904-complete.title: Camping 101: Fishing

97907-accept.name: Brakk
97907-accept.text:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
97907-accept.title: Camping 101: Mining

97908-accept.text:

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.

97946-accept.text:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $c. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.

97977-accept.name: Tarindrella
97977-accept.text:
The Gnarlpine furbolg would not turn on their ancient allies so readily. We must learn more of their plight.

Search their abandoned homes for totems. If any survived the chaos of their departure, their engravings may tell us more of what happened here.

You'll find their camps along the western edge of the glen, though the grell and grellkin may have scattered them beyond.
97977-accept.title: Nature's Call

97977-complete.name: Tarindrella
97977-complete.text:
Oh, it's even worse than I thought.

These engravings tell us that the Gnarlpine began having nightmares of being wiped out by some great shadow. Before long, that fear turned to rage--and the shadow to their former elven friends. To be aware of your own mind slipping away from you...

Our only hope is that this may help us better understand what is happening on Teldrassil. Thank you for your aid, $N.
97977-complete.title: Nature's Call

97977-progress.name: Tarindrella
97977-progress.text: Don't worry about any larger totems you might find. I wouldn't know what to do with them if you found a way to get them!
97977-progress.title: Nature's Call

97979-accept.name: Shanda
97979-accept.text:
You are born kaldorei--the children of the stars--and have inherited a birthright unlike any other in this world. Elune's grace may illuminate our strengths, helping our strikes hit true, or it may help conceal us just as the moon may eclipse the sun.

Our Long Vigil after the defense of Mount Hyjal has ended, and we have joined an Alliance of others--which you will meet in due time. For now, you are nestled in the boughs of Teldrassil.

Demonstrate Mother Moon's gifts, and bask in her blessings.
97979-accept.title: The Goddess Provides

97979-complete.name: Shanda
97979-complete.text: You have seen what our goddess provides. Use it well, and she will never forsake you.
97979-complete.title: The Goddess Provides

98025-progress.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
98025-progress.text: Greetings $c - what may the Sentinels assist you with today? Perhaps you are here to inquire about the bounty on Jai'vhanel?
98025-progress.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

98067-accept.name: Sentinel Dalia Sunblade
98067-accept.text:
General Feathermoon ensures all sentinels have time to pray to Elune. A proper huntress wields not blade alone, but gifts of the goddess to overcome our enemies.

You may help with my daily duties. Place sentinels around the city--start with the tunnels leading beneath Cenarion Hold to the north, the bank at the center of town, the inn in the Craftsman's Terrace to the northeast, and the city gates. The guards can assist you.

Something is amiss in Teldrassil--we must remain vigilant.
98067-accept.title: Eyes of the Sentinels

98067-complete.name: Sentinel Dalia Sunblade
98067-complete.text: I thank you for your aid. Though I find peace in the daily rituals, it is nice to have a moment to reflect instead.
98067-complete.title: Eyes of the Sentinels

98321-accept.name: Tognus Flintfire
98321-accept.text:
Hoha! Good to see a $r who's not afraid to get their hands dirty.

If yer lookin' fer work, I'm afraid I'm a little short on supplies at the moment. Our most reliable source of ore has been overrun by wendigo and now the cave has been abandoned. The miners had to drop everything when they fled!

Say, why don't ye poke yer head around the Grizzled Den to the west and see if you can find some of our missing shipments. It would save us a great deal o' trouble.
98321-accept.title: Flintfire's Shipment

98322-accept.name: Senir Whitebeard
98322-accept.text:
Spelunking dark caves is adventurer business. My job's just to make reports and send them over to Ironforge.

Trouble is, one of my reports hasn't... well, reported back. I asked a few mountaineers to learn more about the wendigo problem we have out here, but I haven't heard from them.

If you're already going to be out and about, what say you don't check in with Mountaineer Gretchen just west of town. I'm late enough as it is!
98322-accept.title: Secure the Mountain

98391-accept.name: Laurna Morninglight
98391-accept.text:
Blessings to you, $c. The Sisterhood of Elune has stood as a pillar of kaldorei society for thousands of years.

Before the Great Sundering, before the War of the Ancients, through the Long Vigil, we have guided and healed our people through the darkness. Such is our charge, and such is the demand of the peerless Mother Moon.

We now require your aid in a matter of great importance. Sister Aquinne awaits your arrival in Darnassus.
98391-accept.title: The Sisterhood of Elune

98391-complete.name: Sister Aquinne
98391-complete.text: I am glad you arrived so quickly. The Sisterhood requires your aid.
98391-complete.title: The Sisterhood of Elune

98403-accept.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
98403-accept.text:
Lord Melenas did not act alone; he was at the behest of another. The one you seek is Xethorr the Wicked. It seems he has twisted the spiders that call Teldrassil home, intending their venom for some foul plan.

He has taken residence deep in the forest, in the area to the northwest of here known as the Cleft. Take caution, and bring allies, for Xethorr is not an opponent to be trifled with.

Dispatch his brood, and bring me anything that may tell us more of the satyr's work here.
98403-accept.title: Twisted Hatred

98403-complete.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
98403-complete.text:
I should have known this was being used to twist the spiders of this land.

I have heard whispers of this substance being the source of much of the corruption plaguing us. Though this is not the original, it is an older sample and may yield more information than what we have obtained so far.

Normally I would have you send this to Darnassus for further study. However, it is best we kept this quiet for the moment, or Dolanaar will never recover its reputation.

I trust you to do the same.
98403-complete.title: Twisted Hatred

98403-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
98403-progress.text:
<Tallonkai lowers his voice.>

Does Xethorr still walk freely?
98403-progress.title: Twisted Hatred

99046-accept.name: Sentinel Kyra Starsong
99046-accept.text:
The Council of the Forest sent a small group of sentinels to the Oracle Tree some time ago. The tree sends messages to our elders, and it falls to us to deliver them to Darnassus safely.

I received word that our most recent runner has not yet arrived. The Oracle's messages vary in frequency, but it has been abnormally long.

Please head towards the Oracle Glade along the road to the west and check on her. It would have been Eralya Leafshadow's turn, and she is still in training. Elune guide you.
99046-accept.title: The Lost Runner

99046-complete.name: Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow
99046-complete.text: Elune's grace... I shall not die... alone...
99046-complete.title: The Lost Runner

99047-accept.name: Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow
99047-accept.text:
My sisters and I... were dispatched... Oracle Tree...

Tree... message. I... harpies... everywhere...

<Eralya coughs up blood, grimacing through the pain.>

I may not have long... no one coming. Please... Byancie... in Dolanaar...
99047-accept.title: Not Dead Yet

99047-complete.name: Byancie
99047-complete.text:
The harpies have become afflicted by the same foulness showing up throughout the forest. I'm sure that is what ails Sentinel Eralya as well.

We must hurry. It won't be long before she succumbs to her injuries.
99047-complete.title: Not Dead Yet

99048-complete.name: Heglan Shadeeye
99048-complete.text:
Heglan's body lies cold within the wreckage of the hut.

Whatever killed her doesn't seem to be human. There may be signs of what happened nearby.
99048-complete.title: A Missing Hand

99049-accept.name: Heglan Shadeeye
99049-accept.text:
The nearby area is destroyed with obvious signs of a skirmish. Whatever ambushed Heglan didn't make it out unscathed. There's probably signs nearby of what happened.

Orgnil will probably want to see any evidence left by the attackers.
99049-accept.title: Threat from Below

99049-complete.name: Orgnil Soulscar
99049-complete.text:
This banner and blade piece belong to the naga! They must have come down the coast from the north.

We cannot let them establish a foothold here. The pressure from both directions would be too much for Razor Hill.
99049-complete.title: Threat from Below

99050-accept.name: Byancie
99050-accept.text:
I will need your help acquiring the ingredients I need to stop the affliction long enough for Eralya to make it back here for further treatment.

Thankfully, our living home is still bountiful and will provide in our time of need.

The core ingredient is dewy lasher fronds. You'll find them around Lake Al'Ameth directly south of here, or Wellspring Lake and its river to the northwest.

In addition, I'll need an empty vial and some spring water. Both can be bought here in town, or traded for.
99050-accept.title: The Great Tree Provides

99050-progress.name: Byancie
99050-progress.text: Do you have the ingredients? I fear Eralya may not have long.
99050-progress.title: The Great Tree Provides

99051-complete.name: Orgnil Soulscar
99051-complete.text: Hopefully that sends them packing back to the north. I'll have some grunts keep an eye out for any stragglers or funny business.
99051-complete.title: Threat from Below

99051-progress.name: Orgnil Soulscar
99051-progress.text: Hopefully those snake scum aren't giving you trouble?
99051-progress.title: Threat from Below

99053-complete.name: Sentinel Kyra Starsong
99053-complete.text:
Thank Elune you were around to help Lynessa avoid a dark fate with the Gnarlpine. She's one of our best, and a personal friend.

Please, take this in thanks. May it serve you well in keeping the kaldorei safe.
99053-complete.title: Escaping Ban'ethil

99158-accept.name: Maxan Anvol
99158-accept.text:
There's a priest out in the mountains that belongs to an organization called the Argent Dawn. They're a holy group that is dedicated to finding and destroying the unholy and unnatural.

Father Gavin though, he's mostly the type that seeks to help and heal everyone rather than grab a weapon. He's fixed up an old building to serve as a rest spot for travelers and called it Misty Pine Refuge. I've got a shipment of holy candles that I need to get him. Could you bring them to him if your going that way?
99158-accept.title: Dawn in the Mountains

997-accept.name: Syral Bladeleaf
997-accept.text:
Are you heading to the south?  To Lake Al'Ameth?  If so, then I have a task I might ask of you...

My colleague Denalan has a camp along the eastern end of the lake, where he is studying and experimenting on the plant life of Teldrassil.  He requested a package of rare earths from Darnassus and it was late, only recently arriving here in Dolanaar.

Can you take the package to him?
997-accept.title: Denalan's Earth

997-complete.name: Denalan
997-complete.text:
Ah, it's here!  I have waited for this rare earth for quite some time.  I hope it's still fresh...

Thank you for bringing it to me, $N.  You are a $r who is generous with her time.
997-complete.title: Denalan's Earth
